or numerical response experiment is authorized by this packet.

## E00. Establish two exact reference identities first

Preserve the historical Citlali JINC control, its actual PCA learning, empirical
S/N and any flux cut, recurrence, support/weights, stopping and products. The
historical method is a practical baseline and fallback, not a scientifically
failed algorithm. Faster accumulation and simple early stopping remain rejected
in the exposed pointing tests; the UID 4460 diagnosis-only lane stays closed.

First bind its executable/environment, data/calibration/geometry, ordered
configuration, effective and realized settings, products and existing metrics.
Then specify a distinct ordinary/naive-MAP reference. Mapmaker changes and any
required coefficient/support adaptation must be explicit. Where every other
choice can be held fixed under admitted contracts, this bridge can isolate the
mapmaker change. Where it cannot, label the bridge a comparison of declared
method combinations; do not attribute all differences to the mapmaker.

For the proposed selector comparison, define a single ordinary-MAP base with
the r0.3 recurrence, current-residual PCA recipe, fixed D_a/contributors,
projection, gridding family, extent and terminal rule. Its baseline admission
policy is the recovered empirical S/N rule, adapted only through explicitly
declared response/noise/quantity compatibility. An historical flux cut is
preserved in the exact historical control; it is not automatically added to
the new comparison. If S/N evidence is not available under the proposed MAP
bundle, that baseline is unavailable until Q05 supplies it. Formal gamma/Q is
not a substitute noise estimate.

Retain all-support/both-sign admission as a separate intentionally unthresholded
baseline definition. It is useful for testing how much nuisance structure the
model path preserves, but it adds no source-purification claim. It need not
become an extra arm of every experiment.

## E01. First screen: one POINT case, one selector change

Proposed initial scope: one representative POINT observation, its predeclared
null/no-source diagnostic where justified, and a small known-truth injection
set addressing offset, nonnominal width/shape and source strength around the
decision boundary. Reserve a different pointing observation for replication;
do not tune the first policy using its outcomes. Observation IDs, injection
counts/amplitudes, admissible stage, truth and null laws are Q05/Q06 bindings,
not selected data in this delivery.

Compare two arms on the same ordinary-MAP base: empirical S/N admission versus
one mode-aware policy using soft localization/scale information and explicit
contamination alternatives. Q01 must finish that policy's statistic, prior
bounds, numerical rule/ties, evidence and sign before the screen. “Coherence”
or “confidence” is not a complete selector. Do not implement or inspect trial
outcomes to fill those definitions afterward. All causal evidence for a model
applied at k+1 must exist in Q_k and other predeclared available context before
that action; injected truth and later/replication outcomes are evaluation-only.

Hold the PTC recipe/configuration fixed across arms, while each arm relearns
centering and subspace on its own current residual. Sharing a frozen bootstrap
subspace is not this comparison. Hold flux estimator (unfiltered total map),
unity application, no additional flux floor, mapmaker, coefficient/support
policy and extent fixed. One major changed choice is the selector. A later
floor, gain or PTC-estimator comparison needs a separate stated question and
holds the other choices fixed. The unthresholded arm may be proposed if a
specific leakage question cannot be answered by these two arms; it is not
permission for an expanding sweep.

For cleaning/relearning claims, inject into the admitted measured/CAL-stage
parent before current residual formation and PTC Learn, with exact signal,
calibration, response and population authority. Because B07 preserves the
ordinary simulation-population exclusion, that experimental input amendment
must be separately bound. A final-map injection may test the inference/flux
construction in isolation; it cannot test atmosphere relearning or the whole
loop. Nulls retain their construction and shared-data limitations.

Predeclare fixed-support metrics and acceptable changes before running:
source/flux recovery; centroid offset bias; width/shape and residual morphology;
residual leakage and false model promotion; signed perturbation evolution;
MAP support and changing admitted support; convergence facts and terminal
causes. Include erroneous positive and negative model perturbations, including
near-threshold entry/revocation; report measured versus unconstrained modes.
Use modest predeclared threshold/prior variations as sensitivity checks, not
an outcome-driven parameter search. Preserve complete science and feedback
products at each pass. Report runtime and peak aggregate process-tree memory
separately from scientific quality.

A method earns further work only through a useful recovery/contamination
advantage for its intended regime without unacceptable bias, instability or
support loss. Visual improvement alone does not pass. Numerical acceptance
margins and the evaluation estimator/response/noise meanings must be selected
before the screen. A promising first screen requires independent-pointing
replication before a policy recommendation. A negative or inconclusive result
is useful: retain it, stop expanding the search, and return to the simpler
historical/S/N-supported contract unless a specific new fact justifies another
bounded question. This is not qualification or a generic superiority claim.

## E02. Next mode question, only if justified: OOF

Propose a small separately selected archive pair covering near-focus and
strongly defocused response, with declared independent replication before any
OOF policy recommendation. Compare the historical S/N-based admission with
one fully specified OOF candidate; keep PTC recipe and numerical reconstruction
fixed as in E01. The candidate may investigate coherence, but no core/seed,
ring, contiguity or narrow morphology is required and none is truth. Do not
combine coherence and cross-focus borrowing in the first comparison.

Evaluate structure/flux recovery and manufactured structure using suitable
known-truth cases and declared response/noise evidence, including faint,
distributed and disconnected structure. Visual inspection can guide case
selection, not define recovery. Cross-focus information is a separate
experimental policy with explicit dependence and leakage controls; learning
the answer from held-out truth or forcing the surface under measurement is
not permitted. Near-focus and strong-defocus policies may differ if evidence
warrants it. This proposal does not authorize OOF reconstruction/fitting.

BEAM and SCIENCE retain M05's testable interfaces now, without launching a
cross-mode matrix. Before any later case, bind its actual quantity and metrics:
detector location/calibration flux and differences for BEAM; compact-source
flux/false promotion under a declared search for blank fields; profile,
faint-outskirts and legitimate signed recovery for extended/mixed fields.
Ensemble borrowing, detailed priors, mixed-policy composition, extra floors,
non-unity gain and alternative PTC families remain explicitly experimental.
